meta_description: WRH Decorators Leicester. Professional interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Free quotes, reliable service. Call 07879 991340.
hero_subhead: From interior refresh to complete exterior transformation, we deliver quality finishes on time and on budget.
services_subhead: We handle everything from a single bedroom refresh to full property renovation—interior walls, exterior cladding, wallpapering, and specialist finishes.

services.title: Interior Decorating
services.desc: Wall painting, ceiling work, and feature walls in your choice of finish. We prepare surfaces properly for a smooth, long-lasting result that transforms your space.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior paint for fascias, soffits, doors, and woodwork. We use premium coatings designed to withstand Leicester's climate and keep your home looking fresh.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Professional hanging of modern and traditional wallpapers, including difficult patterns and textured finishes. Our expert prep and technique means no bubbles, no seams showing.

services.title: Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Venetian plaster, faux effects, and decorative techniques that add character and depth. Perfect for statement walls or creating a bespoke look in period properties.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Office spaces, retail units, and commercial properties decorated to schedule. We work around your business hours and manage disruption professionally.

services.title: Prep & Repair Work
services.desc: Full surface preparation including plasterboard repairs, cracks filled, and sanding. Proper prep is the secret to professional results that last—we never cut corners.

about_pullquote: We prep properly and finish right—no shortcuts, no excuses.
about_para_1: WRH Decorators has been transforming homes and businesses across Leicester for over 15 years. Founded on the principle that proper preparation and attention to detail separate a decent job from an exceptional one, we've built our reputation one satisfied customer at a time. Every project, whether a single bedroom or a full commercial fit-out, receives the same level of care and craftsmanship.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen, we turn up on time, and we leave your property spotless. We're not the cheapest, but we're the most reliable—and homeowners in Leicester know that a £200 saving on a botched paint job isn't a saving at all. We specialise in period properties, modern interiors, and tricky finishes that other decorators avoid.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had our whole house decorated by WRH—living room, hallway, bedrooms, the lot. The lads were tidy, polite, and finished on schedule. Paint job looks immaculate, no drips, no mess. Honestly can't fault them. Would book them again in a heartbeat.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Our kitchen needed wallpapering and we were worried about the pattern matching. From day one the team knew exactly what they were doing. Came out perfect, even around the tricky corners. Fair price too. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Susan K.

reviews.text: Booked WRH to paint the exterior of our Victorian terrace—fascias, soffits, doors. The prep work was thorough and the finish is spot on. They took pride in what they were doing. Best decorators we've used in 10 years of owning this house.
reviews.author: Marcus T.
